name: Amelya Balz
bio: Amelya Balz (also known by her birth name Amalia Tambunan) is an Indonesian TV host, master of ceremonies (MC) and actress.

credits.title: Ratu Petaka
credits.overview: Behind the glitz and glamour of the Ratu Indonesia pageant, five beauty queen contestants harbor a dark secret: they are responsible for the death of a fellow contestant—a tragedy brought about by the bullying they inflicted upon her just before the grand final.
